Tucker Carlson presents what he calls a secret cure for Alzheimer's, depression, and anxiety. The episode title says Big Pharma has kept the cure hid. Carlson builds the case in his own voice and with his guest's help.

Carlson lays out the cure claim and the proof he says backs it. He argues drug firms gain too much from sick minds to free a cheap fix. He names the rules that keep such cures at the fringe, as he sees them. Listeners get a bold health claim in full. The library holds the episode as a record of the claim, not as medical advice.
podcast-joerogan-HDgQBk1wl3M:
Skeptic Michael Shermer spars with Rogan in episode 1888 of the Joe Rogan Experience, their latest round in a long series. Shermer, a Scientific American columnist and founder of Skeptic magazine, makes his living testing strange claims. Rogan enjoys hosting him as a counterweight to wilder guests.

The two argue over belief itself: why minds see patterns, why smart people defend odd ideas, and what counts as proof. Shermer brings studies and debunking habits. Rogan brings the experiencer's side. The episode is a friendly fight about evidence, and it shows how the show checks its own fringe with a resident doubter.
